title: flywheel: flywheel_emit_agy input
description: Check, write, or prune the Antigravity (agy) port of this plugin by running scripts/sync-agy.sh --json --target <targetDir>. targetDir must sit inside cwd or the Antigravity plugins directory (~/.gemini/antigravity/plugins).

targetDir.description: Port directory, e.g. ~/.gemini/antigravity/plugins/agent-flywheel (absolute or relative to cwd)

mode.description: check=report drift without writing, write=update the port, prune=also delete files the port no longer ships

pluginRoot.description: Optional agent-flywheel checkout holding scripts/sync-agy.sh. Must be inside cwd or match CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
